record.question: Which of the following High Courts ruled that the Comptroller and Auditor General can audit the books of accounts of private sector telecom companies?
record.explanation: Answer A: Delhi High Court. The Delhi High Court delivered the 6 January 2014 judgment allowing CAG access to private telecom licensees' records to audit government revenue share. CAG's own audit manual identifies that court and date and distinguishes the later Supreme Court judgment. Historical/source note: Audit jurisdiction concerned government revenue from licensed public resources; not an unlimited general audit of every private business. Reference: https://cag.gov.in/uploads/act_and_mannual/Merged-Manual-064c9ebeb900754-06606429.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
